rules: Only these four identifiers are valid; invalid or inaccessible saved preferences default to polished
Switching changes presentation only: preserve actors, identities, poses, goals, routes, desks, questions, monitor ownership and camera
A retains the current original directional illustrated employees and textured office
B uses existing stable human and robot families as volumetric employees with softer furnishings and lighting
C uses deliberate low-resolution nearest-neighbor scene rendering while native DOM text, speech, controls and private content stay sharp
D uses actual faceted employee geometry and matte simplified office finishes
Style-specific resources are finite and reusable across repeated switches; removed actors and context loss clean owned resources
SVG fallback and Top-down remain usable with an honest 3D-unavailable indication; no physics or provider execution changes
The concept board is an art-direction reference, not a promise that generated raster scenes are interactive assets
